title: narcissus serotinus var. obsoletus
intro: Narcissus serotinus var. obsoletus, commonly known as the autumn-flowering daffodil, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the narcissus plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus serotinus var. obsoletus include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
